-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def mvcc.chanIdAssigned (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (id : w64) (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  id ↪[γc.ids]□ w

theorem mvcc.WatchParams.C_persistent (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (ch : GoChan) : Persistent (P.C ch)

theorem mvcc.idAssigned_agree (γ : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (id : w64) (w w' : Loc) : mvcc.idAssigned γ
    id w ∗ mvcc.idAssigned γ id w' ⊢ ⌜w = w'⌝

theorem mvcc.idsInv_assign (γ : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (hγ : γ.ids = γc.ids)
    (IDS : GMap w64 Loc) (NX aid : w64) (w : Loc) (h : 0 ≤ sint.Z aid ∧ sint.Z aid < sint.Z NX ∧ ∀
    (i : w64), (IDS !! i).isSome = true → 0 ≤ sint.Z i ∧ sint.Z i < sint.Z aid) : ghostMapAuth γ.ids
    1 IDS ∗ ghostMapAuth γ.fresh 1 IDS ⊢ |==> (mvcc.chanIdAssigned γc aid w ∗ mvcc.idsInv γ NX ∗
    mvcc.idAssigned γ aid w ∗ mvcc.idTok γ aid)

theorem mvcc.isWatchStream_persistent (ws : Loc) (wa : GoInterface) (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (γ :
    mvcc.WsStreamNames) : Persistent (mvcc.isWatchStream ws wa P γ)

theorem mvcc.aboveCnt_assign (n : w64) (w : Loc) (WM : GMap w64 Loc) (hb : sint.Z n < 2 ^ 63 - 1) :
    mvcc.aboveCnt (n + W64 1) <[n := w]>WM ≤ mvcc.aboveCnt n WM

theorem mvcc.WatchParams.WC_persistent (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (w : Loc) : Persistent (P.WC w)

theorem mvcc.idAssigned_persistent (γ : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (id : w64) (w : Loc) : Persistent
    (mvcc.idAssigned γ id w)

def mvcc.watchStreamInv (ws : Loc) (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (ch : GoChan) (γc :
    mvcc.WatchChanNames) (γ : mvcc.WsStreamNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ nextID closed cm wm CM WM,
      "HnextID" ∷
          typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchStream go!"nextID"
              ws)
            nextID (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Hclosed" ∷
            typedPointsto
              (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchStream go!"closed"
                ws)
              closed (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          "Hcf" ∷
              typedPointsto
                (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchStream
                  go!"cancels" ws)
                cm (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            "Hwf" ∷
                typedPointsto
                  (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchStream
                    go!"watchers" ws)
                  wm (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              "Hcm" ∷ ownMap cm (DFrac.own 1) CM ∗
                "Hwm" ∷ ownMap wm (DFrac.own 1) WM ∗
                  "%Hdom" ∷ ⌜∀ (id : w64), (CM !! id).isSome = (WM !! id).isSome⌝ ∗
                    "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜∀ (id : w64) (w : Loc), WM !! id = some w → w ≠ null⌝ ∗
                      ("#Hws" ∷
                          □
                            ∀ id w,
                              ⌜WM !! id = some w⌝ -∗ P.IW w ∗ P.OC w γc ∗ ∃ r fcs lo, P.IWF w r fcs lo ∗ ⌜r.id = id⌝) ∗
                        ("#Hcs" ∷ □ ∀ id c w, ⌜CM !! id = some c⌝ -∗ ⌜WM !! id = some w⌝ -∗ mvcc.cancelSpec P c w) ∗
                          "Hids" ∷ mvcc.idsInv γ nextID ∗
                            "Hcl" ∷
                              if closed = true then mvcc.watchStreamOpen γ ∗ □ ∀ id w, ⌜WM !! id = some w⌝ -∗ P.WC w
                              else
                                ∃ L,
                                  P.CR ch γc L ∗
                                    (□ ∀ w, ⌜w ∈ L⌝ -∗ (∃ id, ⌜WM !! id = some w⌝) ∨ mvcc.cancelledFor P γc w) ∗
                                      ⌜sint.Z nextID + ↑(mvcc.aboveCnt nextID WM) ≤ ↑L.length ∧ L.length + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝)

theorem mvcc.chanIdAssigned_persistent (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (id : w64) (w : Loc) : Persistent
    (mvcc.chanIdAssigned γc id w)

structure mvcc.WatchChanNames : Type where
  ch : ChanNames
  recv : GName
  regl : GName
  reg : GName
  ids : GName
  prog : GName
  sentl : GName
  regi : GName
  rsn : GName

def mvcc.cancelSpec (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (c : GoFunc) (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ □ ∀ Φ, True -∗ ▷ (P.WC w -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP ((intoVal c) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

theorem mvcc.WatchParams.F_persistent (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (f : GoFunc) : Persistent (P.F f)

structure mvcc.WatchParams.{u_1} (GF : BundledGFunctors) : Type u_1 where
  IW : IProp GF
  WC : IProp GF
  C : IProp GF
  F : IProp GF
  CR : IProp GF
  R : IProp GF
  T : IProp GF
  IWF : IProp GF
  OC : IProp GF
  WS : IProp GF
  IW_pers : Persistent (self.IW w)
  WC_pers : Persistent (self.WC w)
  C_pers : Persistent (self.C ch)
  F_pers : Persistent (self.F f)
  IWF_pers : Persistent (self.IWF w r fcs lo)
  OC_pers : Persistent (self.OC w γc)
  WS_pers : Persistent (self.WS w)

def mvcc.aboveCnt (n : w64) (WM : GMap w64 Loc) : Nat :=
  (GMap.filter (fun i x => decide (sint.Z n ≤ sint.Z i)) WM).size

theorem mvcc.progFact_persistent (g : GName) : Persistent (mvcc.progFact g)

theorem mvcc.WatchParams.WS_persistent (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (w : Loc) : Persistent (P.WS w)

def mvcc.watchStreamOpen (γ : mvcc.WsStreamNames) : IProp GF :=
  token γ.tok

theorem mvcc.WatchParams.IW_persistent (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (w : Loc) : Persistent (P.IW w)

theorem mvcc.rsnFor_persistent (g : GName) (id : w64) : Persistent (mvcc.rsnFor g id)

theorem mvcc.idTok_excl (γ : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (id : w64) : mvcc.idTok γ id ∗ mvcc.idTok γ id ⊢
    False

def mvcc.isWatchable (wa : GoInterface) (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ wi,
      ⌜wa = GoInterface.ok wi⌝ ∗
        (□
            ∀ key endk fcs k e fs startRev id ch γc L Back,
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  (ownSlice key k DFrac.discard ∗
                      ownSlice endk e DFrac.discard ∗
                        ownSlice fcs fs DFrac.discard ∗
                          ([∗list] f ∈ fs, P.F f) ∗
                            P.C ch ∗
                              P.CR ch γc L ∗
                                P.R ∗
                                  P.T ∗
                                    ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z startRev ∧ id ≠ W64 (-1)⌝ ∗
                                      ∀ w, ⌜w ≠ null⌝ ==∗ mvcc.chanIdAssigned γc id w ∗ Back w) -∗
                    (▷
                        ∀ w c,
                          ⌜w ≠ null⌝ ∗
                              P.IW w ∗
                                P.OC w γc ∗
                                  mvcc.cancelSpec P c w ∗
                                    P.CR ch γc (w :: L) ∗
                                      P.R ∗
                                        (∃ lo, P.IWF w (mvcc.watchRangeOf k e endk startRev id) fcs lo) ∗
                                          ⌜(w :: L).length + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗ P.WS w ∗ Back w -∗
                            Φ (intoVal w, intoVal c)) -∗
                      WP
                        (((((((intoVal (methods wi.ty go!"watch" wi.v)) (intoVal key))
                                  (intoVal endk))
                                (intoVal startRev))
                              (intoVal id))
                            (intoVal ch))
                          (intoVal fcs))
                        {{ Φ }}) ∗
          (□
              ∀ w,
                □
                  ∀ Φ,
                    P.IW w ∗ P.R -∗
                      ▷ (P.R -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                        WP
                          ((intoVal (methods wi.ty go!"progress" wi.v))
                            (intoVal w))
                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
            (□
                ∀ m dq M γc o ch L,
                  □
                    ∀ Φ,
                      ownMap m dq M ∗
                          (□ ∀ id w, ⌜M !! id = some w⌝ -∗ P.IW w ∗ P.OC w γc) ∗
                            mvcc.progFact γc.prog ∗ mvcc.progCompl P γc M o ch L ∗ P.R -∗
                        (▷ ∀ b, ownMap m dq M ∗ mvcc.progCompl P γc M o ch L ∗ P.R -∗ Φ (intoVal b)) -∗
                          WP
                            ((intoVal
                                (methods wi.ty
                                  go!"progressAll" wi.v))
                              (intoVal m))
                            {{ Φ }}) ∗
              □
                □
                  ∀ Φ,
                    P.R -∗
                      (▷ ∀ r, P.R -∗ Φ (intoVal r)) -∗
                        WP ((intoVal (methods wi.ty go!"rev" wi.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

theorem mvcc.aboveCnt_skip (n : w64) (w : Loc) (WM : GMap w64 Loc) (hn : WM !! n = some w) (hb :
    sint.Z n < 2 ^ 63 - 1) : mvcc.aboveCnt n WM = mvcc.aboveCnt (n + W64 1) WM + 1

theorem mvcc.WatchParams.IWF_persistent (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (w : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange)
    (fcs : GoSlice) (lo : Nat) : Persistent (P.IWF w r fcs lo)

def mvcc.rsnFor (g : GName) (id : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Ψ, savedPredOwn g DFrac.discard Ψ ∗ □ Ψ id)

def mvcc.progCompl (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (M : GMap w64 Loc) (o :
    Bool) (ch : GoChan) (L : List Loc) : IProp GF :=
  if o = true then iprop(P.CR ch γc L ∗ □ ∀ w, ⌜w ∈ L⌝ -∗ (∃ id, ⌜M !! id = some w⌝) ∨ mvcc.cancelledFor P γc w)
  else iprop(□ ∀ id w, ⌜M !! id = some w⌝ -∗ P.WC w)

def mvcc.progFact (g : GName) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Q, savedPropOwn g DFrac.discard Q ∗ □ Q)

def mvcc.idsInv (γ : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (nextID : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ IDS,
      ghostMapAuth γ.ids 1 IDS ∗
        ghostMapAuth γ.fresh 1 IDS ∗
          ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z nextID ∧ ∀ (i : w64), (IDS !! i).isSome = true → 0 ≤ sint.Z i ∧ sint.Z i < sint.Z nextID⌝)

def mvcc.cancelledFor (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(P.WC w ∗ ∃ r fcs lo, P.IWF w r fcs lo ∗ mvcc.rsnFor γc.rsn r.id)

theorem mvcc.idsInv_next (γ : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (IDS : GMap w64 Loc) (NX idp aid : w64) (w : Loc)
    (h : (idp ≠ W64 0 ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z NX ∧ ∀ (i : w64), (IDS !! i).isSome = true → 0 ≤ sint.Z i ∧
    sint.Z i < sint.Z NX) ∨ 0 ≤ sint.Z aid ∧ sint.Z aid < sint.Z NX ∧ ∀ (i : w64), (IDS !! i).isSome
    = true → 0 ≤ sint.Z i ∧ sint.Z i < sint.Z aid) : ghostMapAuth γ.ids 1 IDS ∗ ghostMapAuth γ.fresh
    1 IDS ⊢ |==> (mvcc.idsInv γ NX ∗ (⌜idp ≠ W64 0⌝ ∨ mvcc.idAssigned γ aid w ∗ mvcc.idTok γ aid))

def mvcc.idTok (γ : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (id : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ w, id ↪[γ.fresh] w)

theorem mvcc.WatchParams.OC_persistent (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (w : Loc) (γc :
    mvcc.WatchChanNames) : Persistent (P.OC w γc)

structure mvcc.WsStreamNames : Type where
  tok : GName
  ids : GName
  fresh : GName
  prog : GName
  sentl : GName
  rsn : GName
  regi : GName

theorem mvcc.aboveCnt_delete (n id : w64) (WM : GMap w64 Loc) : mvcc.aboveCnt n (GMap.delete id WM)
    ≤ mvcc.aboveCnt n WM

def mvcc.isWatchStream (ws : Loc) (wa : GoInterface) (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (γ :
    mvcc.WsStreamNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ch γc,
      "%Hγc" ∷ ⌜γ.ids = γc.ids ∧ γ.prog = γc.prog ∧ γ.sentl = γc.sentl ∧ γ.rsn = γc.rsn ∧ γ.regi = γc.regi⌝ ∗
        "#Hwa" ∷
            typedPointsto
              (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchStream
                go!"watchable" ws)
              wa DFrac.discard ∗
          "#Hch" ∷
              typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchStream go!"ch" ws) ch
                DFrac.discard ∗
            "#HC" ∷ P.C ch ∗
              "#Hwable" ∷ mvcc.isWatchable wa P ∗
                ("#Hclose" ∷
                    □
                      ∀ L,
                        □
                          ∀ Φ,
                            (P.CR ch γc L ∗ □ ∀ w, ⌜w ∈ L⌝ -∗ P.WC w) -∗
                              ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                                WP
                                  ((intoVal
                                      (functions go.close
                                        [go.ChannelType go.sendrecv
                                            go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.WatchResponse.ty]))
                                    (intoVal ch))
                                  {{ Φ }}) ∗
                  "#Hmu" ∷
                    sync.isMutex (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchStream go!"mu" ws)
                      (mvcc.watchStreamInv ws P ch γc γ))

def mvcc.watchRangeOf (k e : List w8) (endk : GoSlice) (startRev id : w64) : mvcc.WatchRange :=
  { key := k, end? := if endk = slice.nil then none else some e, startRev := startRev, id := id }

theorem mvcc.cancelSpec_persistent (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) (c : GoFunc) (w : Loc) : Persistent
    (mvcc.cancelSpec P c w)

theorem mvcc.isWatchable_persistent (wa : GoInterface) (P : mvcc.WatchParams GF) : Persistent
    (mvcc.isWatchable wa P)

def mvcc.idAssigned (γ : mvcc.WsStreamNames) (id : w64) (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  id ↪[γ.ids]□ w
